content.short: Self-custody stablecoin neobank giving businesses a global dollar account, checkout, payroll and invoicing.
content.description: AllScale opens a dollar account for a business in seconds, without a bank application or a seed phrase, and keeps the funds in self-custody. On top of that account it offers crypto checkout, invoicing, real-time payroll and card spending, with KYC, KYB and on-chain transaction screening built in. It is aimed at small companies paying and getting paid across borders, and is backed by YZi Labs and Animoca Brands.
content.meta: Open a self-custody dollar account for your business and run checkout, payroll and invoicing in stablecoins with compliance built in.
